active_miss_rate: Job-level mean(actual>K0); exactly identical to point underprediction for this duration replay. Also report GPU-weighted any-miss rate and active-miss GPU 5-min slot rate against actual active GPU slots.
decision_order: C if a primary diagnostic population has fewer than the frozen 100 jobs
B if pooled interval contains .5 and any supported primary conditional population interval excludes .5
A if pooled and all supported primary intervals contain .5
diagnostic_calibration_readout: Descriptive Wilson 95% interval for P(actual>K0), checked against 0.5; report UTC-day block bootstrap sensitivity separately. This is a post-selection statistical readout, not a changed point acceptance threshold or proof of production readiness.
historical_comparison: V40I forensic COMPLETED H100 ~64.13%, user-supplied historical summary, no V40I outcome read
V40J development COMPLETED H100-standby ~73.64%, separate population and split
V40K April pooled K0 50.061%, separate population and split
quantile_definition: NumPy linear quantile on residual actual-K0; positive residual Q90/Q95 use strictly positive residuals only; normalized residual=(actual-K0)/requested_seconds, valid positive requests only
retrospective_interpretation: Status-conditioned diagnostics do not redefine Q50(T|causal X). A conditional completed-group error can coexist with calibrated pooled unconditional Q50; no final status used as prediction feature.
scope: Existing POINT_HOLDOUT_PREDICTIONS.parquet only for outcomes; frozen previously exposed training population only for causal support counts. No new holdout opening, model prediction, fit, calibration, threshold tuning or candidate selection.
support_definition: Reuse V40J exact9/other8 SupportGuard against V40K final-fit historical rows end-known before 2025-04-01; no support threshold change
